# Sunny Coast AC

> Licensed AC repair and installation company serving Miami-Dade and Broward, Florida (Cool Now South Florida LLC d/b/a Sunny Coast AC). FL license CAC1825130, licensed and insured. There is no charge to come out: repair visits include an 18-point system check, and the customer only pays for work they approve. New-system in-home estimates are also $0. Flat price in writing before any work.

Website: https://sunnycoastac.com/
Phone: +1 (786) 822-6861 (call or text)
Email: admin@sunnycoastac.com
Hours: Monday–Friday 7:00 AM – 9:00 PM; Saturday 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM; Sunday closed
Based in: Homestead, FL
Service area: Miami-Dade County and Broward County, Florida
Team: Javier and Yosbel (co-owners and technicians), 12+ years each in AC work
Track record (as of November 5, 2026): 12,000+ AC jobs done by our team since 2020; 4.9 stars from 65+ Google reviews

## Services
- [AC repair](https://sunnycoastac.com/services/ac-repair/): Diagnosis and repair of AC not cooling, leaking, noisy, or frozen; $0 to come out, customer pays only for approved work
- [New AC / replacement](https://sunnycoastac.com/services/ac-replacement/): $0 in-home estimate for a new system; options and prices in writing; most new system installs done in one day; financing on qualifying installs
- [Ductless mini-splits](https://sunnycoastac.com/services/ductless/): Mini-split installation and repair
- [AC maintenance](https://sunnycoastac.com/services/maintenance/): Tune-ups, drain line clearing, coil and electrical checks
- [Diagnostic Visit](https://sunnycoastac.com/services/diagnostic-visit/): What the 18-point system check covers ($0 to come out)
